ONCOLOGY CONSULTATION PROGRESS NOTE
Patient ID: PT-000007
Demographics: 60-year-old male presenting for Cycle 4 evaluation.

DIAGNOSIS & MOLECULAR PROFILING:
Primary Diagnosis: Stage III SCLC.
Genomic Profile: Confirmed driver mutation in KRAS. Secondary mutation: Wild-type.
Tumor mutational burden measured at 3.4 mut/Mb with ctDNA level of 0.68 ng/mL.

CLINICAL ASSESSMENT & LABORATORY REVIEW:
Vitals: Blood pressure 128/74 mmHg, Heart rate 47 bpm, SpO2 97% on room air.
Serum Chemistries: Serum creatinine 1.09 mg/dL, Liver function enzymes 5.0 U/L, Hemoglobin 13.9 g/dL.
Patient currently demonstrates mild febrile neutropenia and severe fluid retention. Physical examination reveals no jaundice, no acute respiratory distress, and clear lung fields bilaterally.

TREATMENT PLAN & REGIMEN:
Administer scheduled therapy with Docetaxel at a dosage of 161.8 mg.
Pre-medications ordered per protocol. Serial monitoring of renal markers and complete blood count scheduled prior to next infusion.
